newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bargain-hunting lifts Nintendo shares in morning.
newsitem.headline: Bargain-hunting lifts Nintendo shares in morning.

text.p: Nintendo Co Ltd shares rose in Friday morning trade, lifted by bargain hunters, brokers said.
As of 0033 GMT, the shares were 180 yen higher at 7,680 yen on the Osaka bourse.

The shares were depressed on Thursday due to news that a videogame software maker would develop and supply the latest version of its best-selling software packages for Sony Corp's 32-bit game player PlayStation.
Media reports on Wednesday -- a national holiday -- said Enix Corp, which in the past supplied Nintendo Co Ltd with Dragon Quest software, would develop the new version exclusively for Sony.
